tool.title: OpenAPI ingest from a published spec
tool.description: Ingest the OpenAPI documents an instance's `cat-openapi.config.json` lists under `rendered` by fetching each published spec URL (https), verbatim, with a provenance recording the URL, when it was fetched and the document's sha256 — a URL has no commit, so the digest pins the bytes. A failed fetch or bytes that are not OpenAPI 3 write nothing and never replace a held copy.

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: The instance root holding `cat-openapi.config.json` and the declared `openapi` directory.

outputs.name: documents
outputs.description: `<id>.openapi.json` and `<id>.source.json` per rendered document, in the declared `openapi` directory.

selection.when: The spec is only available as a published document (a rendered IG or docs site), or the repository should stay remote while its spec is ingested.
selection.limits: Reads what the publisher serves at fetch time; whether it has changed since is answered only by fetching again and comparing digests.
selection.cost: One https GET and one JSON parse per document.

$comment.comment:
Published IGs are served from GitHub Pages or from smart.who.int; each
is built from a repository, and `openapi-ingest-source` reads the same
spec from a local checkout of it, pinned to a commit, with no network.
